title: tehas drain --json
description: The object tehas drain --json prints, version 1: the limit of no new work it has set, and what still runs. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. limit holds the same reading as api/limit.schema.json without api, and cycles and plan are always there because drain always writes both. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the sample beside this file against it.
